merge_rules.pinned_procedures: Union by procedure_id and verify every ID against dependency_catalog.json.
merge_rules.escalation_paths: Union all active route_id values and verify their owner groups.
merge_rules.recent_notices: Deduplicate by notice_id only when timestamp and content are identical.
merge_rules.source_handling: Archive both original manifests only after the consolidated file passes zero-loss validation; do not discard either source.
